messages:
alerts-bot: ALERT at 17:52 UTC — paging pipeline 'notify-orchestrator' failing to deliver. webhook-proxy responding 502/timeout, suppression kicked in. sample curl:
```
curl -v -X POST https://webhook-proxy.internal/pager -d '{"id":"p-123"}'
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< X-Notify-Status: suppressed
```
We auto-suppressed deliveries to avoid spam. Investigate and triage.

emma (oncall): seeing the suppressed count spike. customers complaining they didn't get pages. switching to manual mode. @jen do we have manual roster?

aaron (sre-lead): I can confirm spikes right after the 17:45 deploy. logs show upstream keepalive errors and an increase in 502s. grabbing proxy logs now.

lucy (eng-infra): taking traffic off the proxy cluster (route -> fallback) and pausing automation. will attempt quick rollback of proxy image to previous stable.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by lucy for service webhook-proxy -> tag v1.2024-10-28. estimated 2m.

maria (support): flagged 3 paid customers (acct ids 9981, 7742, 5566) — they opened tickets about missed pages. notifying account teams.

jen (ops): manual paging roster: sending SMS via fallback-relay to oncall list. will also escalate to phones for the affected customers. posting progress here.

aaron (sre-lead): lucy, can you paste the exact error snippets? need to check TLS handshake vs backend timeouts. I see `read tcp ...: connection reset by peer` in proxy stderr.

lucy (eng-infra): here are tail lines:
```
2024-11-02T17:46:03Z proxy: upstream read timeout: id=p-12345, conn=12, error="read tcp 10.0.2.5:443: read: connection reset by peer"
2024-11-02T17:46:05Z proxy: 502 -> suppressed delivery id=p-12345
```
Rollback completed — routing back to v1. Health checks green in 30s.

deploy-bot: rollback finished successfully. traffic weight -> stable v1.2024-10-28.

emma (oncall): monitoring suppressed count — dropping. manual SMS sends in progress. ping @maria once you confirm customer notifications sent.

maria (support): notified accounts, created follow-up SLO ticket. customers offered manual re-sends and incident summary.

jen (ops): manual paging finished for active incidents. confirmed delivery to all oncall numbers we had. added note: need better fallback automation.

aaron (sre-lead): root cause looks like proxy change that increased concurrent connections and triggered upstream resets. action items:
- lucy: open PR to revert connection pool defaults + add canary for proxy changes (owner: lucy)
- devops-bot: add automated smoke test that simulates 30 concurrent pages before deploy
- maria: customer comms template (owner: maria)
- emma: retro and oncall playbook update for manual fallback flow

devops-bot: created ticket INFRA-2348: "proxy canary + smoke test for paging pipeline" and linked runbook.

emma (oncall): marking incident as mitigated — pages are flowing again and manual fallback completed. will keep watch for 1 hour then close. :white_check_mark
_meta: generated for dataset: slack incidents; single slack thread containing root message + replies
